newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: OTIS JUMPS 8 PCT AFTER STRONG RESULTS.
newsitem.headline: OTIS JUMPS 8 PCT AFTER STRONG RESULTS.

text.p: Shares in South African elevator firm Otis Elevator Company Ltd surged on Thursday on the back of the group's strong earnings for the half year ended May 31.
By around 0845 GMT Otis had added 35 cents or 7.87 percent to 480 cents, making it one of the Johannesburg Stock Exchange's biggest percentage gainers.
But volumes were small as only 17,200 shares valued at around 80,720 rand changed hands.
"This is usually a thinly traded stock. They are up a little bit, but nothing great," one dealer said.
"They've increased their dividend and its better than the previous year and that could be the reason why they are going a little bit better today," the dealer added.
Otis on Thursday posted earnings per share at 30.4 cents from 28.1 cents previously.
The dividend was pegged at 20.0 cents from 18.0 cents before. The company said that it expected continued improvements in its earnings for the second half.
